title: ESMA Retail Leverage Cap Enforcement (1:30 Limit)
precondition: Retail investor under European ESMA regulation joins MAM group.
expected_result: Sizing engine enforces 1:30 maximum leverage limit for ESMA client child tickets; reduces lot size to comply.
actual_result: Retail classification enforces 1:30 maximum leverage limit on child tickets, clamping lot sizes to comply with European ESMA rules.
